reviewMethod: Read-only final diff and actual WebGL2 fragment-shader test script/result review; no independent browser rerun.
sourceFindings: Ordinary soil no longer inherits indexed base color through either the34percent palette blend or mountain-contact exposed-rock inheritance. Both remain geologicalEarthRock-only.
Ordinary roughness and reflectance are stable constants; wetness is a bounded world-field value; legacy curvature is removed.
Ordinary ambient lighting no longer consumes legacy materialSignal; geological and other material branches retain it.
Geological rock hue inheritance, cavern material attenuation, shoreline/contact logic, true normals, geometry buffers, root population, selection and draw paths are unchanged by this repair.
Correction to earlier diagnosis: normal-based base multiplier in the non-soil else branch does not execute for ordinary soil.

fragmentTest.type: Actual renderer fragment shader with synthetic WebGL2 vertex fixture
fragmentTest.fixedInputs: Ordinary role1/materialModel1; approximately x200,y20,z-350; up normal; coast/contact100; same light and camera.
limits: One sampled position/normal/light fixture and two attribute variants; not exhaustive shading proof.
Fixture x200 is outside mountain-contact region; geological-only exposedRock guard is source-reviewed, not separately activated by this pixel test.
Clearing/habitat/shadow feature uniforms default disabled in synthetic fixture; their preservation is source-reviewed.

fullSceneEvidenceLimit: Two-view candidate-material-repair run precedes the final exposedRock and ambient isolation guards. It is supporting earlier-stage runtime evidence, not a final full-scene qualification of this exact source.
